name: weekly-certification-uswds
title: Weekly Benefits Certification — USWDS
description: How the form looks, for the USWDS adapter — the Definition says nothing about appearance. How to read it: `adapter` names the render adapter this theme is written for (`uswds-site`, which ships its own stylesheet, so there is no stylesheet list and no palette here). `tokens` retunes the adapter's rhythm: `spacing.field` between questions and `spacing.section` above a titled section, both 2rem as the design frames space them. `selectors` pick a widget by what an item is: every `choice` question becomes radio buttons, every `text` answer a 5-row area with a 200-character count. `items` pick by key — the benefit-week notice as an info alert, `Divider` for the hairline items, hidden legends on the groups the frames show no heading for (the fieldsets keep their accessible names), and `allowAdd`/`allowRemove` locks that keep the record-supplied employer rows fixed. `defaults.requiredIndicator: none` — the frames mark no field as required; the form still enforces it.
